name: Strong Foundation
overview: Scripture emphasizes the necessity of a strong and sure foundation in the life of the believer and in the work of God. The foundation of the house of the LORD is a cause for great praise and thanksgiving, reflecting God's enduring mercy (Ezra 3:11). The Psalms warn that if the foundations are destroyed, the righteous are left without hope (Psalms 11:3), while the rejected stone becomes the indispensable cornerstone (Psalms 118:22). Isaiah reveals that the Lord Himself lays a tested, precious cornerstone in Zion as a sure foundation, promising stability for those who believe (Isaiah 28:16). Jesus confirms this truth by likening those who hear and obey His words to a wise man who builds his house upon the rock (Matthew 7:24), underscoring the importance of Christ as the unshakable foundation for life and faith.
